title: No Playwright e2e test has run on any PR since 2026-09-07 — the suite dies at a static lint gate before any browser opens, and the job name hides it
description:
**BLUF — no Playwright test has executed on any PR since 2026-09-07. The** `Playwright suite` **job goes red at a static lint gate that runs BEFORE any browser opens, so the red names the wrong subject and the coverage hole has been invisible for three days.**

This is a **test-coverage** ticket, not a CI-config ticket. It was found while measuring CI gate failures (KS-1075) but must not be closed as gate tuning: the gate is a symptom, the missing e2e coverage is the defect.

## What happens

`Playwright suite` (job in `.github/workflows/pr-platform-suites.yml`) fails at **step 6, "Quality gate — static (tsc/ESLint/Prettier/knip/audit)"**. That step runs `npm run format:check && npm run lint && …` ahead of the suite. It exits 1, so **the job stops before a single browser test runs.**

```
  27:1  error  Missing JSDoc @param "label" declaration  jsdoc/require-param
  27:1  error  Missing JSDoc @throws declaration         jsdoc/require-throws
  27:1  error  Missing JSDoc @example declaration        jsdoc/require-example
  48:1  error  Missing JSDoc comment                     jsdoc/require-jsdoc
✖ 4 problems (4 errors, 0 warnings)
```

All four in `systemTest/playwright/global-setup.ts`. Prettier passes cleanly — it is the ESLint jsdoc rules alone. ESLint's own output says **3 of the 4 are** `--fix`**-able**.

## Why it hid — the part worth keeping

**The job's name names the wrong subject.** "Playwright suite :: failure" reads as *browser tests ran and failed*. Nobody re-reads a suite they believe is already running. The same shape as a wrapper printing a banner it did not earn: the red was true, and what it implied was false.

## Proven pre-existing, with controls

* Measured identically on **two unrelated PRs** — #938 (one nginx `location` block, zero service code) and #939 (TypeScript type declarations in one service): same rules, same line numbers, same count.
* `global-setup.ts` is touched by **neither** — 0 hits in each diff, against controls of 4 and 3 files actually touched.
* Last changed `42e778203`, **2026-09-07**, *"KS-969 round 2: a role collapse is not a success…"* — three days before either PR.

## What needs doing

1. Fix the four jsdoc errors in `systemTest/playwright/global-setup.ts` (3 are `--fix`-able).
2. **Then confirm the suite actually runs and report what it finds** — three days of unrun e2e may be hiding real failures. A green job after the lint fix is not the same as a suite that was green all along, and it must not be reported as one.
3. Consider whether a static lint gate belongs *ahead* of the suite in the same job at all: as configured, any lint error in the harness silently converts "e2e coverage" into "no e2e coverage" while still reporting a normal-looking red.

## Related

Found during KS-1075 (CI gate measurement, commissioned by Kam as `measure-then-decide`). KS-1075 covers the two *other* gate causes — a `bash -e` swallowed diagnostic and an empty npm-audit allow-list — and should not absorb this one.

nodes.body:
**BLUF:** Kam ruled on 2026-11-10 to split this gate: the static and unit gates become their own jobs, and the Playwright job always runs its browser tests. Nothing is built by this comment; the workflow edit is a separate seat's build and Kam merges it.

**What was ruled.** Card `secuura-ks1076-playwright-gate-design-1109`, option a: "Split it: static and unit gates become their own jobs; the Playwright job always runs its browser tests". The edit is to `.github/workflows/pr-platform-suites.yml`. This answers item 3 of this ticket, which comment 90ba2f54 (2026-09-14) left as "a workflow-design call, Kam's; not taken here".

**What this does not do.** It does not edit the workflow or change this ticket's state or priority. It does not say whether the failing unit cell named in comment 90ba2f54 passes today; that was not measured. The extra CI minutes the split costs were not measured either.

**Verify-only record (2026-09-14, s215) — measured from the live Actions runs, not re-run; no edit, no state move. Assigned to the board account (was unassigned).**

**Item 1 — the four jsdoc errors in `systemTest/playwright/global-setup.ts`: already fixed on develop.** Commit `6a047445b` ("reunite globalSetup with its docblock — playwright lint is red on develop"), merged via PR #896 (`38a919d40`, 2026-09-11). Live confirmation: on develop's own push at `8861e6216`, `pr` run 34755906547 / job `Playwright suite` 103721950421, **step 6 `Quality gate — static (tsc/ESLint/Prettier/knip/audit)` = SUCCESS**. Same at the 2026-09-13 PR heads that ran since.

**Item 2 — "confirm the suite actually runs and report": it does not, and the reason has moved one step later.** In the same job, **step 7 `Quality gate — unit suite (test:unit)` FAILS** on the Playwright harness's own unit test — `✖ assertSlotNamedForLocalTarget › refuses every slot's gateway when no slot is named, naming both forms of the slot command` (`AssertionError: Missing expected exception: slot 1`; expected `/^Error: No stack slot named…SECUURA_STACK_SLOT=2 npx playwright test --project=api…/`). Steps 8 `Boot isolated platform stack`, 9 `Install Playwright browser engine`, 10 `Run Playwright API tests` are **SKIPPED**; step 11 uploads nothing (`No files were found with the provided path: systemTest/playwright/results/`). **So no browser test has executed at M18** — this ticket's own sentence ("a green job after the lint fix is not the same as a suite that was green all along") is the finding, one gate further on. **The newest record confirms it (2026-09-14):** the `pr` run 34785721735 at PR #942's head `53b9c3cc1` (= its branch + develop `8861e6216`), job `Playwright suite` 103802165697 — step 6 static SUCCESS, **step 7 FAILURE on the same one cell** (`ℹ tests 348 · pass 347 · fail 1`: `assertSlotNamedForLocalTarget › refuses every slot's gateway when no slot is named…`, `Missing expected exception: slot 1`), steps 8–10 SKIPPED, step 11 `No files were found … systemTest/playwright/results/`. Same at develop's own M18 push run. The unit test is the harness's own (`systemTest/playwright/**`), not a product test.

**Item 3 — whether a static gate belongs ahead of the suite:** a workflow-design call, Kam's; not taken here.

**Board search** for the failing symbol before recording: `assertSlotNamedForLocalTarget` 0 hits (nonsense-token control 0). The `systemTest/playwright/**` unit suite belongs to no current lane; whether a ticket is filed for the step-7 red is the coordinator's call. **Not closed as gate tuning** — nothing here changes what the job enforces.
